name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1865: Found reviewing v1864, which was my own fix for this exact defect class. The vault sweep reported the tab-chrome OCR being silent by reading counters that count for the life of the PROCESS, so in the long-lived console one successful probe ever makes heard non-zero forever and the warning could never fire again however completely the reader died afterwards. It takes a baseline before the sweep and reports the delta now, and the guard asserts the baseline is taken before anything is probed.
